changes: capture_anchor accepts optional accumulation_evidence_versions=() without changing AnchoredCapture schema.
Extra IDs must be a bounded immutable tuple of nonempty strings, unique and lexically sorted; overlap with actual formation evidence IDs is rejected.

Combined formation and accumulation evidence count is bounded before graph evidence lookup. Every evidence item must resolve as actual EvidenceVersion, exact same instrument, observed measurement purpose, and event/known clocks at or before cut.
Combined lineage is retained through graph.lineage_closure((anchor_version_id, *extra_ids), cut), with existing capture byte limit retained.

validate_anchor obtains actual formation IDs from the graph and derives extras from captured evidence by set difference; it reconstructs via capture_anchor and compares the entire capture, rejecting detached/altered payloads, missing formation rows, duplicate rows and noncanonical ordering.
bind_anchor_members remains unchanged: exact capture digest must occur in authenticated captured evidence.
default_compatibility: Empty extras preserve original evidence tuple, lineage seed tuple, dataclass fields and serialized content/hash. Existing default producer behavior is unchanged.
integration_requirements: Publisher must retain independent accumulation receipts as direct current ObjectRevision evidence, so F10 current-source checks apply to corrections.
Initial birth source origins must include the stable accumulation source ID; corrected receipts extend that same source identity without revising immutable formation anchor or its evidence source.

Capture is a historical read and does not independently select latest source revision. Current support remains enforced by F10 direct object evidence; old historical captures remain reconstructible at their original cut.
Root owns separate actual formation confirmation and MP19 fixture/publisher updates.
validation: Read-only source inspection after patch; no imports, tests, compilation, private execution, normalizers or candidate runs. No other source files, goldens, maps, reviews, reports, or source planning modified.
